tests.name: process tags > names the press and coater tags of the 3a interface, with units and decimals
process-readings wire validator > accepts the wire shape of the 3a interface
process-readings wire validator > refuses a value as a JavaScript number, an exponent, an unknown member, a missing member or an empty batch
process-readings wire validator > refuses an unknown tag, another unit, more decimals than the tag carries, a negative count and a read-back of a measured tag
process-readings wire validator > refuses a repeated or reordered sequence number of one device within a batch; devices count apart
process-readings wire validator > setpoint downloads and their acknowledgement
ebmr.sim-process.v1 codec > parses requests and answers, refusing another id, a wrong shape and bytes outside printable ASCII
ebmr.sim-process.v1 codec > frames LF-ended lines across chunks and sets an over-long line aside
market code content (D-S4-1) > holds EU FMD and US DSCSA as unit-level serialised markets and India Schedule H2 as a batch-level QR without serials
market code content (D-S4-1) > builds the EU unit identifier from the record values as GS1 element strings, fixed-length first, GS after a variable one
market code content (D-S4-1) > builds the US product identifier only from a GTIN that carries the NDC
market code content (D-S4-1) > [PR-42] refuses a code whose encoded lot or expiry differs from the record, and accepts one that carries them
L3 contract: pools, serial states and the hashed report > takes a pool request with the quantity as whole decimal text, never a number or zero
L3 contract: pools, serial states and the hashed report > allows only the serial state changes of the contract
L3 contract: pools, serial states and the hashed report > [PR-42] reports zero unexplained only when every serial has a state, with counts that add up
L3 contract: pools, serial states and the hashed report > hashes the canonical report text: stable for the same pool in any serial order, different when a state differs
equipment data (6b-0) > [DI-32] a status code reads GOOD, UNCERTAIN or BAD from its severity bits
equipment data (6b-0) > [DI-32] the shown value must be exactly the raw value the device sent: exponent forms are equal, a rounding is refused
equipment data (6b-0) > [DI-32] a series chunk keeps raw values, source timestamps and status codes; its hash covers every sample
equipment data (6b-0) > [meta] OPC UA node ids derive from the released tag names, both ways, for every tag
equipment data (6b-0) > [DI-20] an endpoint is SignAndEncrypt with an enrolled certificate thumbprint and its room; None mode is refused
equipment data (6b-0) > [DI-49] an alarm occurrence states its transition, code, limit and source time; an equipment event its kind and state
equipment data (6b-0) > [meta] the OPCUA and EMS contracts list their message types with version 1 schemas
